SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4487
D 4487 24/2 P.P

CONFIDENTIAL

February 23, 33.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your letter No.C.I.D. 14/1320/33 of February 7 and to forward herewith a copy of the photograph and criminal record of Leit Buxdorf alias Leib Booksdorff alias Leo Boogedorff, who claims to be a Rumanian citizen of Russian Jewish origin, born on May 1, 1910 at Kishinev, Bessarabia (formerly Russian territory). He holds passport No.9645 issued by the Public Safety Bureau at Shanghai on January 5, 1933 which states that he is a Rumanian.

Enquiries show that Booksdorff went to Harbin from Bessarabia in 1917 accompanied by his family, and after completing his education at the "Andersen School" in Harbin obtained employment in 1928 with the "Harbin Zaria" newspaper as a compositor from which position he later resigned following a quarrel with the manager. He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in 1929 and was employed with the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" from October 1929 until November 1930 when he proceeded to Harbin. Returning to Shanghai in 1931 he rejoined the same paper in May of that year, but in April 1932 he was compelled to resign on account of unsatisfactory service. Nothing is known regarding his subsequent activities with the local branch of the "United Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R."

（左侧手写批注：Touched 24/2）

谨此确认收到阁下1933年2月7日第C.I.D. 14/1320/33号来函，并随函附上莱伊特·布克斯多夫（Leit Buxdorf），又名莱布·布克斯多尔夫（Leib Booksdorff），又名利奥·布格多尔夫（Leo Boogedorff）的照片及犯罪记录副本一份。此人自称是出生于比萨拉比亚基希讷乌（前俄罗斯领土）的俄裔犹太籍罗马尼亚公民，出生日期为1910年5月1日。他持有上海公安局于1933年1月5日签发的第9645号护照，该护照注明其为罗马尼亚人。

经查，布克斯多尔夫于1917年在家人的陪同下从比萨拉比亚前往哈尔滨，在哈尔滨“安德森学校”（Andersen School）完成学业后，于1928年在《哈尔滨霞光报》（Harbin Zaria）担任排字工，后因与经理发生争执而辞职。他于1929年从哈尔滨抵达上海，自1929年10月至1930年11月受雇于《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury），随后前往哈尔滨。1931年返回上海后，他于同年5月重新受雇于同一家报社，但于1932年4月因工作表现不佳被迫辞职。关于其此后在“苏联联合石油托拉斯”（United Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R.）本地分支机构的任职情况，目前一无所知。

（左侧手写批注：2月24日已阅）

A few months ago he applied to H.B.M. Consulate-
General here for a visa for Singapore which was refused
as he failed to produce a letter from an employer in
this city. He proceeded to Canton recently in order, it
is believed, to obtain a visa for Hongkong.

Booksdorff's wife, Easter Abramovna Booksdorff, a
Russian Jewess is a manicurist by profession and resides
at No.21 Tracy Terrace while his mother is the proprietress
of a grocery store at No.85 Route Vallon, both addresses
being located in the French Concession.

Booksdorff is reputed to have radical tendencies
and is also said to be a gambler.

I have the honour to be,

Subject (in full) Enquiries from Hongkong Police regarding one Leit. Buxdorf

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

(左侧批注：See also D. 2596.)

With reference to the letter of February 7, 1933 from
the Inspector General of Police, Hongkong regarding Leit
Boxdorf or Booksdor enquiries show that he claims to be a
Rumanian citizen of Russian Jewish origin born on May 1, 1910
at Kishinev, Bessarabia (formerly Russia). He holds passport
No. 9643 issued by the Public Safety Bureau on Jan. 5 1933
at Shanghai which states that he is a Rumanian. This passport
was obtained with the assistance of the local "Rumanian
Association" as L. Booksdorff was born in Bessarabia at present
a Rumania possession, but is doubtful if the Rumanian authority
will recognise the holder of this document as a Rumanian subject.
Booksdorff arrived in Harbin from Bessarabia in 1917 accompanied
by his parents and brother. His mother is the proprietor of the
Grocery Store "Bessarabia" at 85 Route Vallon where she now
resides with her second son who is at present unemployed.
Booksdorff was twice married, his first wife from whom he
was divorced resides in Harbin, his second wife Easter Abramovna
Booksdorff is a Russian Jewess born 1904 in Siberia. She is a
manicurist by profession and resides at 21 Tracey Terrace,
Route des Soeurs.
Booksdorff received a part of his education at the "Anderson
School" at Harbin. In 1928 he was employed with the "Harbin
Zaria" Russian newspaper as compositor but resigned later
following a quarrel with the manager. During 1929 Booksdorff
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and was employed with the
"Shanghai Evening Post/Mercury", No. 17-21 Avenue Edward VII.
from October 1929 until November 1930, he then returned to
Harbin. Sometime during the earlier part of 1931 he returned to
Shanghai and rejoined the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" as

主题（全称） 就一名名为莱伊特·布克斯多夫，又名莱布·布克斯多尔夫，又名利奥·布格斯多尔夫之人，回复香港警方的查询。

由 侦探警员 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

（左侧批注：另见 D. 2596。）

关于香港警察总监1933年2月7日来函查询莱伊特·博克斯多夫（Boxdorf）或布克斯多尔（Booksdor）一事，调查显示，此人自称是出生于比萨拉比亚基希讷乌（前俄罗斯领土）的俄裔犹太籍罗马尼亚公民，出生日期为1910年5月1日。他持有上海公安局于1933年1月5日签发的第9643号护照，该护照注明其为罗马尼亚人。该护照是在本地“罗马尼亚协会”的协助下获得的，因为L. 布克斯多尔夫出生于目前属于罗马尼亚领土的比萨拉比亚，但罗马尼亚当局是否会承认该证件持有者为罗马尼亚臣民尚存疑问。布克斯多尔夫于1917年在父母和兄弟的陪同下从比萨拉比亚抵达哈尔滨。其母亲是华伦路85号“比萨拉比亚”杂货店的店主，她目前与该店店主次子（现失业）同住于此。布克斯多尔夫结过两次婚，与其离婚的第一任妻子居住在哈尔滨；第二任妻子埃斯特·阿布拉莫夫娜·布克斯多尔夫是俄裔犹太女性，1904年出生于西伯利亚。她的职业是美甲师，居住在姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）特雷西台路21号。
布克斯多尔夫的部分教育是在哈尔滨的“安德森学校”（Anderson School）完成的。1928年，他在俄文报纸《哈尔滨霞光报》担任排字工，后因与经理发生争执而辞职。1929年间，布克斯多尔夫从哈尔滨抵达上海，受雇于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）17-21号的《上海晚邮报/水星报》，从1929年10月至1930年11月，随后返回哈尔滨。1931年初的某个时候，他返回上海，并重新加入《上海晚邮报与水星报》，担任

a compositor. He remained with this firm from May 1, 1931
until April 1931 when he was again obliged to resign, his service
being considered unsatisfactory, mainly due to his laziness.
Booksdorff then apparently had the intention to open his
own-printing business but failed to obtain the necessary capital.
A few months ago he applied for a visa for Singapore at the
H.B.M. Consulate-General but the visa was not granted because he
failed to produce a letter from an employer in this city.
Recently Booksdorff proceeded to Canton, it is believed in order
to obtain a visa for Hongkong. Booksdorff has a reputation of a
gambler and of radical tendency. Nothing is known regarding his
employment with the local "United Petroleum Trust of U.S.S.R."
Municipal Police records show that on September 29, 1925
he was convicted under the name of Leo Boogsdorff by the former
Mixed Court at Shanghai for shoplifting (4 counts) and sentenced
to 9 months imprisonment. Booksdorff's description is as follows:
Height - 5' 4½"; dark brown hair; grey eyes; thick-set; fresh
complexion.

POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
HONG KONG.

CONFIDENTIAL.

7th February, 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to enquire whether you
can give me any information concerning a Rumanian
subject named Leit Buxdorf or Booksdorff, who has
applied for a visa to come to this Colony from the
British Consulate at Canton. I am informed that
this gentleman was formerly employed some time ago,
in the Soviet Oil Company's office at Shanghai.
He is by trade a compositor, but I understand that
he has leanings towards "Red doctrine".

I have the honour to be,
Sir,.
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕

p. Inspector General of Police.

The Deputy Commissioner ( Crime),
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.
